page.notes: The scan is only a strip of one column; the years run from the top of the page to the foot. Ink specks and smudges beside the numbers are not transcribed. The first entry "12" may be a partly printed or damaged numeral and is copied as it appears. The "I" in 163I and 164I is a capital I, as printed, not a figure 1. The letter C at the foot is printed text and is copied as a line of the column. The large initial letter of the closing line is shown as A; the first letter may be a larger C, but it is not clearly visible. "ciuitate" is given as "civitate" (u/v rule). Some lines are printed with a trailing comma or colon as shown.
